Lean accepts original Python function bodies inside `triton { ... }`. Caller types, runtime values, constexpr settings and compilation configuration stay outside the quotation. Statements, casts, masks, branches, helpers and operation order remain visible. Actual execution connects to independent mathematics and complete IO judgments.

Coverage: **121 / 183 selected tasks; 19 / 19 examples; 425 checked raw-body mappings. 62 tasks remain.** Sources authored from independent specifications or as counterparts to existing candidates are labelled. Counts cover registered selected revisions; historical library views are not implicitly included.

Keep this PR **draft**. **Do not merge before the user's review.** The full migration remains in progress.

### Latest completed checkpoint: Conv2d and LayerNormOps

Eight complete literal bodies cover both Conv2d FP16/default branches and existing shifted candidates, and LayerNormOps forward/backward plus existing column-mask and row-start reuse candidates. Original selected Python, public theorem statements, mathematical input domains and IO data remain unchanged. The new LayerNormOps candidate Python explicitly documents its origin as a counterpart of the already-existing rewrites.

Conv2d preserves signed pointer arithmetic, masked loads, operand half casts, dot order and complete memory. The historical original-library signed-pointer program is now connected to an explicitly internal positive-pointer proof model by actual masked-load and complete-memory simulation, including all three loops and final stores. There is no false AST identity or added underflow premise. That historical library DSL view is not counted as a literal mapping.

LayerNormOps preserves each optional branch, cast, conditional Mean load, row-loop bound and output. Caller metadata reflects the existing FP32 host contract: Mean is present for plain LayerNorm and absent for RMSNorm. The selected conditional arm is evaluated without accessing an absent pointer. Actual forward/backward execution, independent normalization/gradient formulas, source FP pairs and complete IO are checked for the original scopes.

The combined frontend retains supported dot input precision with FP32 output and supports guarded optional-pointer conditional expressions, including correlated RMS branches and nested loops. Meaningful fixtures and source mutations cover these risks, including the complete aliased nested-load AST and user-name hygiene after temporary allocation. The earlier complete FP4 helper/caller and integer-assignment corrections are retained. Generic signed `tl.full` width propagation is still a separate recorded limit.

### Verification for source `3227d79070da6db233055554475b7d98bef06532`

- **201 affected task/frontend roots plus joint import pass**, with **5028 theorem footprints** checked. Independent Conv2d (95 roots) and LayerNormOps (106 roots) checks are retained alongside joint validation.
- **5929 cumulative roots plus joint import pass**, both warm and independently from an empty project build directory. Only pinned external dependencies are reused; no project objects or `.veritile-cache` are imported from another checkout.
- **7396 local Lean files** in the complete import closure match Git byte for byte.
- **54163 theorems across 2410 defining modules**, including private helpers, pass the standard-base axiom audit. These structural candidates introduce no numerical assumption. Strict model certificates and experimental rules remain separately reported.
- **409 targeted Python tests pass.** The full **654-test** run retains one historical Structural numerical-receipt module import error; the old receipt was not repinned and the failed module is not counted as passing.
- **207 actual official comparator attempts are UNAVAILABLE**: the host provides Landlock ABI v4 instead of required v5 and has no systemd user isolation. No bypass. Torch/Triton are absent; no GPU or new numerical experiment was run.
- Formula, IO/reader organization, progress and body-correspondence guards pass on the exact receipt. Failed development diagnostics remain available.

Matrix-vector multiplication remains a development item: complete Python bodies expose an unsupported `while` statement and require careful connection of unsigned casts to the existing mathematical/native index models. It is not included in the completed count.

Evidence: [`native-conv2d-layernorm-ops-bodies`](https://github.com/VeriInfra-Lab/VeriTile/tree/36aa41c477211f88eba862f90c94d082639cda2f/bench/review-checkpoints/2026-10-29/native-conv2d-layernorm-ops-bodies). Earlier receipts retain their original scope and limits. These are proofs in the stated project models, not a blanket hardware-conformance claim.
